the neuron‐inducible expression of occludin in endothelial cells is enhanced in the presence of neurons and astroglial cells.

the neuron‐induction of occludin expression is not sufficient to form tight junctions and that the presence of astroctyes is necessary for the formation of functional tight junctions.
